title: Harvesting the volatility premium at retail scale

claim.signal: systematic short defined-risk index option spreads (put credit spreads) to harvest the volatility risk premium
claim.universe: index options, one small account with a fixed per-trade risk budget
claim.claimed_effect: a real and persistent volatility risk premium can be harvested at retail scale with capped-loss structures
claim.sample: 2007-2026 modelled grid of 108 configurations; 3 configurations run against real option chains
claim.data_needs: index and volatility history; real option chains for adjudication

protocol.replication_anchor: re-execute the pre-registered selection rule on the modelled grid; recompute the friction breakeven
protocol.kill_criteria_for_the_claim: net edge at or below zero on real chains with conservative fills

verdict.outcome: FALSIFIED — true premise, unreachable conclusion. Real chains with conservative fills: -43.9% net (-6.75% CAGR) on the model's own pick, -14.5% on the earlier candidate; every tested configuration negative
verdict.replication: selection rule re-executed on the 36-config grid: 3 eligible, top by Sharpe is 0.45-delta/2.0% — the runner-up was carried forward instead, a documented discretionary override

diagnostics.friction_cliff: modelled expectancy crosses zero at 0.082 index points per leg vs 0.05 assumed — the entire edge lives inside the first nickel
diagnostics.granularity: mean expectancy rises with width while tradability collapses: 1.0% -> 80 trades after 2021, 3.0% -> 0
diagnostics.win_rate_vs_profit: corr(win rate, expectancy) = +0.48; 57% of the 30 configurations winning >=85% of trades lose money; the best win rate (92.9%) earns $-1.7/trade
diagnostics.model_vs_reality: ranking inverted — the only configuration the modelled grid rated feasible-and-positive was the worst of those traded

honest_limitations: real-chain results and the friction sensitivity table are recorded from the source study, not recomputed here (raw platform logs were not saved)
modelled prices use Black-Scholes with a fixed skew multiplier — adequate for magnitudes, not for a verdict
the pre-registered selection rule was overridden by a documented judgment call
only 3 of 108 configurations were tested against real chains
findings are specific to one small account's risk budget and the index level over the sample
